summary: You pick one of the nine field subplans. The audit checks the 90 graduate units and the subplan's course lists, including repeated enrollments such as ACCT 615 in years 1 and 2 and OB 678 every quarter of years 1 to 3, with each course passed with P or B- or better. Checked by hand: that required courses were taken for a grade where a graded option exists, breadth courses, practicums, research papers, field exams, teaching or course assistantships, candidacy, the oral exam and the dissertation. External credit is not accepted.

program.why: Every subplan: "Each course must be passed with a grade of P or B- or better." (OIT: "P (GSB courses) or B- (University courses)"). The audit lets a P count. "All required courses must be taken for a grade (not pass/fail or credit/no credit)" is not set: GSB grades H and P read as pass grades, and GSB Pass/Fail courses such as ACCT 615 and OB 678 are not marked pass/fail-only in the course data, so a letter-grade rule would reject them.
